Wattrel!!]]''. |noevo=incap |current=[[Party|With Friede]] |java1=[[Kenta Miyake]] |enva1=[[Ed Bosco]] }} '''Friede's Charizard''' (Japanese: '''フリードのリザードン''' ''Friede's Lizardon'') is [[Friede]]'s first known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. It is also used as a means of transportation for both Friede and [[Captain Pikachu]]. It was also co-leader of the Pokémon who belong to Friede's teammates and the group that live on the [[Brave Olivine]]. ==In animation== ===History=== ====Pre-series==== {{p|Charizard}} was likely [[Friede]]'s [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]], as it knew its {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s childhood friend [[Orla]], his teacher [[Lucca]], and his mentor [[Ludlow]]. As shown in ''[[HZ018|Flying Pikachu, Rising Higher and Higher!]]'', Charizard was in the [[Paldea]] [[region]] on Ludlow's boat relaxing while Friede was [[fishing]] until its Trainer got a call to met up with Lucca. Through Lucca, Charizard met a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Pikachu}} that tried to fly and tried to become friends with him, but to no avail. However, after flying Friede to the sky with Pikachu, Charizard help its Trainer save the Mouse Pokémon from falling and he joined their team. After that, Charizard reunited with Orla in [[Hoenn]] as she converted Ludlow's ship into an airship, which became the [[Brave Olivine]], and its teammate was nicknamed [[Captain Pikachu]]. Also, Charizard joined Friede when he with Orla and Ludlow formed the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. Sometime later, Charizard met a wild {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} and befriended it when it came to live on the Brave Olivine, and the Fire Croc Pokémon came to admire it. ===={{aniseries|HZ}}==== [[File:Friede and Charizard.png|thumb|250px|left|Charizard and Friede]] Charizard was first seen in ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' when [[Friede]] came to [[Liko]]'s rescue after [[Amethio]] tried to get her pendant from her. Friede used Charizard in his battle against [[Amethio's Ceruledge]]. Charizard dodges Ceruledge's {{m|Psycho Cut}}, only for it to nearly hit Liko who was trying to escape sending her flying off the [[Indigo Academy]]'s roof. In the [[HZ002|next episode]], Charizard caught Liko and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} and flew them with Friede back to the [[Brave Olivine]] for safety. Using its {{m|Flamethrower}}, Charizard helped get the Brave Olivine moving, only for the Brave Olivine to come under attack from the [[Explorers]]. Once the Explorers boarded, Friede rode on Charizard to confront them in battle. In ''[[HZ005|Found You, Fuecoco!]]'', Charizard was used in the battle against Amethio's {{p|Corviknight}}. Corviknight managed to keep the battle fairly even despite having a type disadvantage. The battle ended without a winner when Amethio decided to go after Liko and her pendant again. [[File:HZ022.png|250px|thumb|Charizard facing [[Amethio]]'s {{TP|Amethio|Ceruledge}}]] In ''[[HZ014|Fly! Wattrel!!]]'', Charizard and Friede pursued [[Spinel]]'s {{p|Magneton}}, who was the cause behind the Brave Olivine's failure to reboot its system. They chased it all the way to [[Levincia]], where they were cornered in a dark alleyway by Magneton and {{p|Beheeyem}}. Despite getting outmatched at first by the combined efforts of Magneton and Beheeyem, Friede {{Tera}}stallized Charizard into a {{t|Dark}} type to fight off Beheeyem's {{m|Psychic}}, and ultimately forced them to retreat after firing off a {{m|Tera Blast}}. In ''[[HZ017|Special Training Time!]]'', Charizard was used in a training battle with [[Captain Pikachu]]. Upon seeing his idol's performance in battle, {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} was motivated to participate in a training battle alongside {{TP|Roy|Wattrel}} against Cap. [[File:OPJ32 Rotom Photo HZ083.png|thumb|left|170px|Charizard battling the Black Rayquaza again]] In ''[[HZ022|Charge! Galar Mine!]]'', Charizard participated in a battle against Amethio's Ceruledge. This time, however, it struggled to keep up with Ceruledge's increased {{stat|speed}} due to the activation of its {{a|Weak Armor}} [[Ability]]. The battle was interrupted as Liko, Roy, and an injured Captain Pikachu passed by them in a minecart while being pursued by a {{rf|Galarian}} {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}} that had an Ancient Poké Ball. In the [[HZ023|next episode]], Charizard and Friede met up with them at the [[Motostoke]] [[Pokémon Center]] after they had managed to escape the [[Galar Mine]]. Later, Charizard was among the Pokémon that battled Moltres in order to calm it down, teaming up with Wattrel to help blow some of Liko's Sprigatito's aromatic {{m|Leafage}} to soothe the Legendary Pokémon. After Moltres had calmed down, the Legendary Pokémon returned to its Ancient Poké Ball. In ''[[HZ024|Reunion at the Ancient Castle!]]'', Charizard was sent out by Friede to confront the Explorers when they infiltrated the [[ancient castle]] where [[Diana]] was living. In the [[HZ025|following episode]], Charizard faced off against Amethio's Ceruledge once again. Despite initially attacking more carefully and from a distance this time, Amethio tricked them into activating Ceruledge's Weak Armor Ability, which allowed it to land a flurry of {{m|Night Slash}}es. Seemingly overwhelmed and about to be hit by a Psycho Cut, Friede Terastallized Charizard into a Dark type, rendering the opposing attack useless, and finished off the battle with a single Tera Blast. After [[Coral]] set off her {{p|Glalie}}'s {{m|Self-Destruct}}, Friede and his Pokémon managed to barely escape the explosion and reunited with the Rising Volt Tacklers. In ''[[HZ045|From So Far Away]]'', Charizard teamed up with Ceruledge to face off against the [[Black Rayquaza]]. Both Pokémon Terastallized and struck with a flurry of powerful moves, but both of them eventually fell to Rayquaza's {{m|Dragon Ascent}}. In ''[[HZ072|The Search for Kleavor!]]'', Charizard was used alongside Captain Pikachu to fend off a pack of {{p|Houndoom}} and {{p|Houndour}} impeding the group's search for [[Lucius's Kleavor]]. In ''[[HZ082|Beyond the Shining Rainbow]]'', Charizard joined the fight against Black Rayquaza, carrying Captain Pikachu and Friede on its back for a series of effective aerial attacks alongside Crocalor and Kilowattrel. However, despite its efforts, Charizard was ultimately knocked out of the sky and defeated by Rayquaza's {{m|Dragon Tail}}. [[File:Friede disappearance.png|thumb|250px|Charizard and Friede disappearing to parts unknown]] In ''[[HZ086|The Rising Volt Tacklers vs. The Explorers!]]'', Charizard partnered with Captain Pikachu in a [[Double Battle]] against Spinel's {{p|Umbreon}} and {{p|Beheeyem}}. Initally, Charizard's weakness to Beheeyem's {{m|Thunderbolt}} was shielded by Captain Pikachu's [[Hidden Ability]], {{a|Lightning Rod}}, but after Beheeyem used {{m|Skill Swap}} to swap its Ability, {{a|Telepathy}}, with Cap's, Charizard was put on the defensive. Knowing Lightning Rod would have Beheeyem teleporting in front of incoming {{type|Electric}} moves, Friede was able to create a plan: Pikachu targeted Umbreon with a {{m|Thunder Punch}}, luring Beheeyem into getting near, while Charizard Terastallized and unleashed a Dark-type Tera Blast in their direction, which knocked out Beheeyem and left Umbreon barely standing. Due to Telepathy's effect, Pikachu was able to dodge its ally's attack and soon finished off the remaining opponent with a {{m|Volt Tackle}}. However, the battle left Friede's Pokémon exhausted, and in the [[HZ087|next episode]], the two weakened Pokémon went berserk due to the [[Laquium]]'s mist and attacked each other, knocking each other out and forcing Friede to [[recall]] them. [[File:HZ122.png|thumb|250px|left|Charizard battling Skeledirge]] In ''[[HZ089|Where the Adventure Leads]]'', Friede sent Charizard out again so [[Liko's Hattrem]] could rejuvenate it with {{m|Heal Pulse}}, restoring its vitality so it could fly Friede, Captain Pikachu, Dot and Liko out of Laqua, while Roy hung onto [[Roy's Kilowattrel|his Kilowattrel]]. As Laqua underwent seismic activity, the group was nearly blown away by a sudden burst of strong winds, but Charizard and Kilowattrel hung tough. Eventually, the group reached a mountaintop, where they were rescued by the rest of the Rising Volt Tacklers piloting the Brave Olivine and using its emergency form to break past its max altitude. However, as soon as Friede and the others arrived, another strong wind hit the Brave Olivine head-on, causing Friede and his Pokémon to be blown back. Friede and Captain Pikachu clung to Charizard, who tried flapping its wings in an attempt to brave the wind, but failed and only managed to grab onto the ship rail with one hand. With Captain Pikachu slipping, Friede used the last of his strength to hand him to Liko and entrust him with taking care of the Rising Volt Tacklers before he and Charizard lost their grip and were sent tumbling back towards Laqua, leaving their fate unknown. A year later, in ''[[HZ100|We Are the Rising Volt Tacklers!]]'', it was revealed in a message sent a month earlier on the Rising Volt Tacklers' [[Rotom Phone]] app that Charizard and Friede have survived the crash but were hiding somewhere due to heavy surveillance by the Explorers. In ''[[HZ122|Roy vs. Friede: Wings of Fire!]]'', Charizard battled against Roy's {{p|Skeledirge}}, having the advantage at first, but after Skeledirge learned {{m|Torch Song}} and both Pokémon Terastallized, Charizard was defeated. After the battle, Charizard was revealed to be capable of [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolving]] into Mega Charizard Y, flying Friede to the space station to continue his research on Laquium. In [[HZ135]], Charizard was sent out to help the group stop the Laquium Core after Spinel merged with it. Unfortunately, Charizard got defeated and was return to its Poké Ball to rest. However, hearing Liko, Roy, Dot, and Amethio's determination to not give up, Charizard reemerged on its own to finish the fight. In the [[HZ136|next episode]], Charizard helped its friends weaken the Laquium Core before Pagogo purify it for good. {{-}} ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Skeledirge and Charizard.png|250px|thumb|left|Charizard and [[Roy]]'s {{TP|Roy|Skeledirge}}]] [[File:Friede Charizard and Captain Pikachu.png|250px|thumb|Charizard and [[Captain Pikachu]]]] Charizard is shown to be a strong Pokémon, as seen in ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' when it was used to battle [[Amethio's Ceruledge]]. Despite this, Charizard is shown to be friendly and playful with other Pokémon, as seen in ''[[HZ004|Found You, Fuecoco!]]'' when it used its tail so that {{p|Fuecoco}} could jump over it. The friendship between Fuecoco and Charizard was shown again in ''[[HZ006|The Ancient Poké Ball]]'', where realizing how close Fuecoco had become to [[Roy]], Charizard gave Fuecoco a {{i|Poké Ball}} so that both could begin their journey. When he evolves into {{p|Crocalor}}, Charizard shows how proud it is of him and gives him a hug after reuniting in ''[[HZ068|Into a New Sky! The Brave Olivine!]]''. Charizard expressed pride again in ''[[HZ122|Roy vs. Friede: Wings of Fire!]]'' when it sees that he had evolved into {{TP|Roy|Skeledirge}} and had defeated it in battle. Charizard shares a strong bond with [[Friede]] and enjoys spending time with him. They also work well together in battle, as Charizard won't hold back no matter who the opponent is. In addition to Friede, Charizard is great friends with [[Captain Pikachu]], as it often hangs out with him and would train with him in battle whenever they could. Charizard even gets along well with Instructor {{p|Starmie}}. As co-leader of both the Pokémon that belong to Friede's teammates and the group that live on the [[Brave Olivine]], Charizard would act as the peace maker of both groups. Although Captain Pikachu is more in charge of both groups, Charizard nevertheless takes its leadership seriously and would take over whenever its teammate wasn't around. Upon seeing Skeledirge's growth in the past year and having a battle with him in ''[[HZ122|Roy vs. Friede: Wings of Fire!]]'', Charizard acknowledged him as an equal and the new co-leader of both Pokémon that belong to Friede's teammates and the group that live on the Brave Olivine. {{-}} ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fire color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{fire color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{dark color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a {{color2|000|Terastal phenomenon|Terastallized}} Charizard ({{color2|000|Dark (type)|Dark}}) ! style="background:#{{flying color light}}; {{roundytr|5px}}" | As a {{color2|000|Mega Evolution|Mega}} Charizard Y |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Friede Charizard Terastal.png|250px]] | [[File:Friede Mega Charizard Y.png|250px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fire|flying|Friede Charizard {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Flamethrower|1=Dragon Claw|2=Tera Blast Dark|3=Air Slash}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Flamethrower|1=Dragon Claw|2=Tera Blast

During the first event, Charizard appeared only during surprise encounters, and during the second event, Charizard appeared only during the raids. ==Trivia== * In ''[[HZ018|Flying Pikachu, Rising Higher and Higher!]]'', [[Lucca]] commented on Charizard's "growth", a possible reference to Friede possessing it while it was still in other {{p|Charmander|stages}} {{p|Charmeleon|of Evolution}}. * Charizard having {{t|Dark}} as its {{Tera|Tera Type}} could be a [[List of cross-canon references|reference]] to the {{ct|Darkness}} Tera {{TCG ID|Obsidian Flames|Charizard ex|125}} from the {{OBP|Obsidian Flames|TCG}} expansion, which was released in Japan a week after Friede's Charizard was seen Terastallizing for the first time. * Charizard is Friede's only Pokémon: ** Who does not have a nickname. ** Has not been seen being {{pkmn2|caught}} in a flashback. * Charizard is the first Pokémon in {{aniseries|HZ}} to be seen using two battle techniques (Terastallization and Mega Evolution), and the second overall to do so, with the first one being [[Ash's Pikachu]], who has used [[Z-Move]]s and [[Gigantamax]]. ==References== {{reflist}} ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Charizard}} {{Friede's Pokémon|fire|flying}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Friede's Pokémon|Charizard]] [[de:Friedels Glurak]] [[es:Charizard de Friede]] [[it:Charizard di Friede]] [[ja:フリードのリザードン]] [[zh:弗里德的噴火龍]]
